# Wildsite

> Wildsite (Erin-Marie Design LLC, DBA Wildsite Co.) designs websites and branding for small businesses in Marin County and the San Francisco Bay Area: hospitality, restaurants, wineries, spas, salons, floral studios, therapy and small medical offices, boutiques and realtors. Creative Director: Erin-Marie Driscoll. Based in Novato, California. Email hello@wildsite.co.

## Services
- [Website packages](https://wildsite.co/websites.html): Simple ($2,200, one to three pages), Standard ($4,200), Premium ($6,200+); Wildsite Club monthly maintenance membership
- [Design by the hour](https://wildsite.co/design-by-hour.html): logos, branded patterns, menus, flyers, postcards, copywriting and web edits in blocks of 3, 6 or 12 hours
- [Flower Art AI](https://wildsite.co/flower-art-ai.html): custom watercolor-style abstract flower art, $39
- [Book a consult](https://wildsite.co/book-a-consult.html): free intro call
- [Contact](https://wildsite.co/contact.html): send a note
